entries.0514106d10cff225: This is a hamburger café offering hamburgers made with freshly baked buns, 100% beef patties and vegetables purchased daily. entries.e4b48ae16a94b5a1: This is a single-segment business operating restaurants in the one metropolis and three prefectures of the Greater Tokyo area and in Osaka Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,460 million, and the number of stores as of February 28, 2026 was 83. It manages its cooking processes under its PPM strategy, which distinguishes, by product, between in-store preparation, processing at its own processing facilities and outsourcing.
entries.f561ed621b36bf9d: This is a chicken izakaya centered on yakitori and other chicken dishes. Its main offering is skewered products such as tsukune cooked in-store, and it is characterized by a price range and product lineup designed for everyday use. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 66, including 2 franchised stores.
